Hello there Tomas.zavrsnik7.



You were wondering why the links in your emails are not working from your inbox? I see that you have started Thunderbird in Troubleshoot Mode. While using this mode, the software should function correctly again?

The issue is likely caused by a glitch in one of your installed software programs, or your add-ons are not fully up to date.

We recommend finding and removing these malfunctioning add-ons or conflicting software.

After doing this, you should be able to use the software normally again.

If the issue persists, reinstalling the software or clearing it of the aforementioned faulty add-ons or software often helps.
